name: Tax ID SD-JWT VC Type Metadata
description: Tax Identification Number (TaxID) per the WE BUILD rb-taxid attestation rulebook.

display.name: Tax ID
display.description: Structured, verifiable evidence of a natural person's tax identification number within a national tax system, bound to their identity.

display.label: Tax number
display.description: Character string that enables the tax authority to uniquely assign the User within the national tax system. The format and structure of this string varies per Member State (combination of letters and digits).

display.label: Tax residence country
display.description: Alpha-2 country code of the User's country of tax residence (i.e. the Member State whose national tax system assigns the tax_number).

display.label: Family name
display.description: Current last name(s) or surname(s) of the User.

display.label: Given name
display.description: Current first name(s), including middle name(s), of the User.

display.label: Date of birth
display.description: Day, month, and year on which the User was born. Expressed as a date (not a datetime).

display.label: Church tax ID
display.description: Character string made up of numbers and letters, identifying the User for church tax purposes.

display.label: IBAN
display.description: IBAN (International Bank Account Number) registered with the tax authority for the User. Formatted in accordance with ISO 13616.

display.label: Issuing jurisdiction
display.description: Country subdivision code of the jurisdiction that issued the TaxID attestation, as defined in ISO 3166-2:2020 Clause 8.

display.label: Legal category
display.description: Indicates the legal category of the attestation.

display.label: Issuance date
display.description: Date and time on which the TaxID attestation was issued.

display.label: Expiry date
display.description: Date and time after which the TaxID attestation is no longer valid.

display.label: Issuing authority
display.description: Name of the administrative authority that issued this TaxID attestation. Where no separate authority is authorised to issue TaxID attestations in the Member State, this field SHALL contain the ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 country code of the respective Member State.

display.label: Issuing country
display.description: Alpha-2 country code (ISO 3166-1) of the TaxID attestation provider's country or territory.

display.label: Trust anchor location
display.description: The URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor to be used for verifying this TaxID attestation can be found or looked up.
